concerns.text: translation_error is defined as disagreement between the 'engine-generated plan' and the greedy ground_truth_plan, but the plan never specifies HOW the engine/router generates its plan. BM25, SQLite, and RDFLib do not produce execution plans. If the simulated router uses the same pre-computed cost table as the reference engine (research.md §2), the comparison is circular — disagreement would be zero by construction or an artifact of injected noise. Specify an independent plan-generation mechanism (different cost model / perturbation process) or the H2/SC-002 analysis is unfalsifiable.

Precision@10 is recorded per query (FR-009) and feeds SC-002's ≤0.02 stability criterion, but the plan never defines a relevance ground truth for the SYNTHETIC queries. Without a defined set of relevant documents per query, Precision@10 is undefined or trivially determined by the generator — specify how relevance judgments are constructed and that they are independent of the retrieval engines.

Subtracting a constant trivial-query baseline assumes latency scales additively (overhead + structural cost). Engine latency typically scales multiplicatively with work; a constant subtraction can leave corrected_latency_ms negative or distort the interaction effect the ANOVA tests. Justify the additive model or use a ratio/log-based normalization.

Timeouts are 'record as failures and latency outliers' but the plan does not state how timeout latencies (censored at 60 s) enter the ANOVA. Including censored values biases means; excluding them biases against the graph-spike hypothesis (selective survival). Specify the treatment (e.g., sensitivity analysis with/without timeouts, or censored-regression) before SC-001 can be interpreted.

concerns.location: research.md §4.3 / FR-007 — sensitivity sweep on 4 level means
concerns.text: Piecewise linear regression and spike detection are computed on mean latency per complexity level — only 4 data points per source type. Slope estimates above/below a spike point rest on 1–2 points each; 'spike significance' with Bonferroni over cutoffs {2,3,4} is not a meaningful test at this sample size. Either use per-query regressions or acknowledge the sweep is descriptive only.
